semiconductor_relevance: High — Seiwa Optical specializes in manufacturing equipment for semiconductor applications, particularly in optical technology.
summary: Seiwa Optical (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of advanced optical equipment designed for semiconductor applications, including CMOS, power devices, LEDs, and MEMS. Their product offerings include double-sided exposure systems, inspection systems, and various measurement tools that enhance manufacturing precision and efficiency.
capabilities: Double-sided Exposure System with alignment accuracy of less than ±1µm

regional_presence.China: Seiwa Optical operates in Shanghai, focusing on the semiconductor equipment market.
